title: LaPaz studies green fireballs following nuclear debris
place_text: University of New Mexico; United States

tellings.quote: in 1948 49 he was basically studying green Fireballs following the plume radioactive debris post nuclear blasts across the US

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells of a scientist named Lincoln LaPaz, linked to the University of New Mexico, who he says spent 1948 and 1949 studying "green fireballs", glowing green lights seen in the sky. According to Michels, the fireballs seemed to follow the plumes of radioactive debris drifting across the United States after nuclear test blasts, which would suggest the lights were taking an interest in nuclear weapons.
